sources.note: Town of Hyde Park (official website), Selectboard page: Chasity Fagnant (three-year term, expires 2027), Savannah Droney (2029), Matt Morin (2027), Russell Jones (2028), and Lance Van Vogelpoel (2028)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): the directory seats the same five (Fagnant as Chair, Droney as Vice-Chair)
Town of Hyde Park (official website), Town Clerk page: 'Elected Town Clerk: Kimberly J. Moulton, Term Expires March 2028'
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): Hyde Park Town Clerk is Kimberly Moulton
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Town Clerk Contact Info' spreadsheet: Hyde Park Town Clerk is Kimberly Moulton

Town of Hyde Park, official monthly newsletter (October-November 2025): 'Town Clerk, Town Treasurer, and Delinquent Tax Collector: Kimberly Moulton' -- the clerk also serves as treasurer and, under the 17 V.S.A. section 2651d default, as delinquent tax collector, so no separate DTC post is created
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): Hyde Park Treasurer is Kimberly Moulton
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2026 VT Treasurers' Contact Info' spreadsheet: Hyde Park Treasurer is Kimberly Moulton

Town of Hyde Park, official monthly newsletter (October-November 2025), 'Town Board of Listers: Deanna Judkins, Chair; Leslie Rollins, Vice-Chair; Krista Jones'. The Listers' February 5, 2026 meeting agenda names the same three

Town of Hyde Park (official website), Cemeteries page (updated September 25, 2026): 'five elected Cemetery Commissioners' -- Christine Cooney (term expires 2028), Kim Lambert (2029), Edward French (2030), Kylah Jones (2031), and Sarrah Patch (2027)

17 V.S.A. section 2646 (official text, Vermont General Assembly) provides for the election of a moderator at annual town meeting. Structure only: no official source publishes the current holder; the seat is left unfilled rather than guessed.
